observations.title: Own null or undefined fake entry still selects live transport
observations.problem: hasOwnProperty checks presence only. For a nonnull map with an own operation property set to null or undefined, the guard passes, and the subsequent value ?? null supplies the production-adapter sentinel. A host can therefore bypass the new fail-closed guard with a malformed map.
observations.reachability: This probe supplies invalid host data directly to an isolated emitted wrapper. TestServiceFakes excludes null/undefined entries; authored fixture lowering emits literal TestServiceFake objects or omits entries, and neither the checked source language nor exported runtime entry surfaces provide arbitrary fake-map injection. No remaining checked authored route to this condition was found. It does not reopen the original empty authored fake finding.
observations.recommendation: For a guard claimed to fail closed on malformed host maps too, reject a nullish operation value before invoking the adapter, or separate test/production dispatch so test-mode lookup can never yield the live null sentinel. Add own-null and own-undefined regression probes. No source fix was made.
observations.harnessLimit: The emitted wrapper body was transpiled without changing its guard or lookup and run with the real generated adapter. Identity request/receipt validators and fixture configuration were supplied by the harness for an already valid payload; this is isolated guard evidence, not end-to-end authored or schema-validation evidence.

observations.note: Loose host fake receipt validation from the original review was outside these two corrections. No new authored receipt exploit is claimed.
